title: Online Correlation Clustering: Simultaneously Optimizing All $\ell_p$-norms
abstract: arXiv:2510.15076v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The $\ell_p$-norm objectives for correlation clustering present a fundamental trade-off between minimizing total disagreements (the $\ell_1$-norm) and ensuring fairness to individual nodes (the $\ell_\infty$-norm). Surprisingly, in the offline setting it is possible to simultaneously approximate all $\ell_p$-norms with a single clustering. Can this powerful guarantee be achieved in an online setting? This paper provides the first affirmative answer. We present a single algorithm for the online-with-a-sample (AOS) model that, given a small constant fraction of the input as a sample, produces one clustering that is simultaneously $O(\log^4 n)$-competitive for all $\ell_p$-norms with high probability, $O(\log n)$-competitive for the $\ell_\infty$-norm with high probability, and $O(1)$-competitive for the $\ell_1$-norm in expectation. This work successfully translates the offline "all-norms" guarantee to the online world.   Our setting i

translated_title: 在线相关聚类：同时优化所有 $\ell_p$-范数
translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.15076v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：相关聚类的 $\ell_p$-范数目标在最小化总分歧（$\ell_1$-范数）和确保对单个节点的公平性（$\ell_\infty$-范数）之间呈现基本权衡。令人惊讶的是，在离线设置中，可以通过单一聚类同时近似所有 $\ell_p$-范数。这种强大的保证能否在在线设置中实现？本文提供了首个肯定答案。我们提出了一种针对在线-带样本（AOS）模型的单一算法，给定输入的一小部分恒定比例作为样本，该算法产生一个聚类，该聚类在高概率下对所有 $\ell_p$-范数同时具有 $O(\log^4 n)$-竞争比，对 $\ell_\infty$-范数在高概率下具有 $O(\log n)$-竞争比，并对 $\ell_1$-范数在期望上具有 $O(1)$-竞争比。这项工作成功地将离线的“全范数”保证转化到了在线领域。我们的设置是……
tldr: 本文首次实现在线相关聚类中，通过单一算法同时对所有 $\ell_p$-范数提供竞争比保证，成功将离线“全范数”优势扩展到在线环境。
en_tdlr: This paper achieves the first online correlation clustering algorithm that simultaneously provides competitive ratio guarantees for all $\ell_p$-norms, successfully extending the offline "all-norms" advantage to the online setting.
